_comment: FOMC meeting calendar from federalreserve.gov (Two Auctions a Day: calendar columns + the pre-FOMC study). Free, no key: the current calendars page (this year ±, 2021-2027 today) plus one historical page per year back to from_year. Every meeting keeps its statement URL; the statement PAGE is fetched once (cached under raw/statements/) to read the 'For release at H:MM p.m. EST/EDT' line — that is the DECISION TIME the minute-bar study needs. Pages older than ~2014 say 'For immediate release' instead, so those meetings fall back to statement_time_rules and carry time_basis='rule'; unscheduled meetings and conference calls without a page time carry null. Validation: every year must show exactly 8 scheduled meetings, or the run fails.

statement_time_rules.note: first Chair press conferences: on those four meetings a year the statement moved to 12:30 p.m., presser 2:15 p.m.; other meetings stayed 2:15 p.m.
every statement 2:00 p.m. ET, press conference 2:30 p.m.
